summary: Brief synthesizes FellowScript's own docs (mission, group-centric feature set, monetization, parchment-and-gold brand identity) against 34 external sources covering ASO, faith-app growth case studies (Hallow, YouVersion, Glorify), competitive positioning (Abide, SmartGroups), campus/church partnership channels, creator/content marketing, and referral/virality mechanics, organized around all 9 plan research steps. Most tactical claims carry 2-4 independent corroborating sources; reliability is generally solid but skews toward two dominant faith-app case studies (Hallow, YouVersion) and several commercially-motivated vendor/agency sources, with an unresolved internal pricing discrepancy across FellowScript's own docs and an undocumented gap on Abide's actual acquisition tactics, both flagged in Risks for downstream stages to weigh.
